name: MonarchMessageComposer
title: MessageComposer
wrapsNative: TextField(_:text:prompt:axis: .vertical) with lineLimit(1...8) and an action row of MonarchButton and plain Buttons; Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented) for modes; onKeyPress(.return) and keyboardShortcut(.return, modifiers: .command) for hardware keyboards; MonarchEmojiPicker in a .sheet; MonarchMentionPicker above the box
summary: The chat and ticket reply box: a growing plain-text field with a send button, mentions, emoji, an attachment row, a draft status, reply and edit contexts, typing callbacks and optional modes such as reply and internal note.
whenToUse: At the bottom of a conversation, thread or ticket, usually in .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom), to write, edit or answer a message.
whenNotToUse: Not for a single-line form value; use MonarchTextField. Not for long formatted documents; rich text waits for the rich text editor. Not for an AI prompt; use the Intelligence prompt components.

options.name: label
options.description: The accessible name of the text field, such as Message #design.

options.name: text
options.description: The text. The app owns it, so it saves and restores drafts.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while the text is empty. A mode's placeholder wins.

options.name: replyTo
options.description: The message being answered: Replying to the author, with a one-line excerpt.

options.name: modes
options.description: Message types as a segmented control above the box. A mode with isNote gives the warning look.

options.name: selectedMode
options.description: The selected mode's value. The composer keeps it, starting with the first mode, when nil.

options.name: mentions
options.description: Mention suggestions. The composer reports the query; the app searches and passes results. Picking writes @Label.

options.name: draftStatus
options.description: The app's draft save state, shown with MonarchSaveStatusIndicator as Saving draft…, Draft saved or Draft not saved.

options.name: sendShortcut
options.description: returnKey: hardware Return sends and Shift-Return adds a line. commandReturn: only Command-Return sends.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: The most characters. Shows a count; over it, the count turns danger and sending is off.

options.name: typingInterval
options.description: The least time, in seconds, between two onTyping calls.

options.name: isEditing
options.description: Edits an existing message: Editing message context, Save title, Cancel button, focus on appear.

options.name: isSending
options.description: Shows the sending state, for apps that track sending themselves.

options.name: hasAttachments
options.description: Allows sending without text.

options.name: showsEmojiButton
options.description: Shows a button that opens MonarchEmojiPicker in a sheet; the emoji is added at the end of the text.

options.name: disabledReason
options.description: Why the composer is disabled, shown under it while .disabled(true).

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the mention and emoji pickers'.

options.name: onAttach
options.description: Adds the attach button. Present the app's file importer or photo picker.

options.name: onDismissReply
options.description: Adds a button that removes the reply context.

options.name: onCancelEdit
options.description: Adds Cancel while editing; Escape on a hardware keyboard calls it.

options.name: onEditLast
options.description: Up Arrow in an empty box on a hardware keyboard.

options.name: onTyping
options.description: Called at most once per typingInterval while the focused text changes.

options.name: onTypingStop
options.description: Called when the text is emptied or sent, focus leaves, or the composer disappears, after onTyping.

options.name: attachments
options.description: The attachment row above the text, such as MonarchAttachmentChip views. Wraps onto new rows.

options.name: actions
options.description: Extra buttons before the send button.

options.name: onSend
options.description: Receives the trimmed text, the mentions still in it and the mode. The text clears when it returns; when it throws the text stays and the error shows under the composer.

states.name: empty
states.description: The placeholder in the subtle text colour; the send button is disabled.

states.name: ready
states.description: Text or attachments present: the send button is enabled.

states.name: sending
states.description: The send button shows a spinner and Sending…; another send is blocked.

states.name: replying
states.description: A context bar with a reply icon, Replying to the author, the excerpt and a dismiss button.

states.name: editing
states.description: A context bar with a pencil and Editing message, a Cancel button and Save instead of Send.

states.name: note mode
states.description: The box uses the warning subtle fill and warning border; the send title can change, such as Add note.

states.name: over the limit
states.description: The count turns the danger colour and the send button is disabled.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring around the box.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle fill and border, disabled text colour, no emoji button, and the reason under the box.

states.name: draft status
states.description: Saving draft…, Draft saved or Draft not saved under the box.

appearance: The box uses the surface fill with the input border, the text in the default text colour and the placeholder in the subtle text colour; the send button is the primary button. A note uses the warning subtle fill and warning border; disabled uses the subtle fill and subtle border. The reply rule uses the strong border colour, the edit rule the accent border. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web composer is a rich text editor with a formatting toolbar; iOS has plain text until the rich text editor exists, so mentions are written as @Label and reported as items. On the web Enter sends; on iOS the on-screen keyboard's Return adds a line and the send button sends, while hardware Return (or Command-Return) sends through onKeyPress and keyboardShortcut. The web shows a send-key hint under the box; iOS does not, because most people type on the on-screen keyboard. Files arrive by paste, drop and picker on the web; on iOS onAttach lets the app present the system file importer or photo picker. The emoji picker is built in as a sheet instead of a product slot, and the emoji is added at the end of the text because iOS 17 gives no caret position. Draft debouncing is the app's: it owns the text binding.
accessibility: The text field is named by label; the placeholder is its prompt.
The reply or edit context is one element read as its title and excerpt; the dismiss button is separate and named Stop replying.
The emoji, attach and dismiss buttons are named icon buttons with 44-point touch targets.
The send button is a MonarchButton; while sending it reads Sending… and is busy.
The character count is read as characters left, or characters over the limit, not as a fraction.
The draft status uses MonarchSaveStatusIndicator, which announces saved and error.
Mention suggestions use MonarchMentionPicker, which announces the result count while focus stays in the text field.
The note mode is named by its segment as well as shown by the warning tint.
The text grows from one to eight lines with Dynamic Type and then scrolls.
edgeCases: Only white space cannot be sent; the sent text is trimmed.
If onSend throws, the text and picked mentions stay.
A mention whose @Label was edited out of the text is not reported.
The same person picked twice is reported once.
selectedMode with a value that is not a mode falls back to the first mode.
Over the limit, typing is not cut; sending is off until the text is shortened.

examples.title: A ticket reply with an internal note mode
examples.setup:
@State private var text = ""
@State private var mode = "note"
examples.code:
MonarchMessageComposer(
    "Ticket reply",
    text: $text,
    modes: [
        MonarchMessageComposerMode("reply", label: "Reply"),
        MonarchMessageComposerMode("note", label: "Internal note", isNote: true, sendLabel: "Add note"),
    ],
    selectedMode: $mode,
    sendShortcut: .commandReturn,
    maxLength: 500
) { _ in }

parityExceptions.reason: The web composer is a rich-text box; the iOS field is plain text with the same formatting row under it, and each tool writes its Markdown marker at the end of the text because SwiftUI's TextField on iOS 17 exposes no selection. The row scrolls sideways when the tools are wider than the box.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: text is edited in the system field; the formatting row scrolls at compact width
